page_builder.label: CRAFT MEETS CAPABILITY
page_builder.heading:
Built by people
who know the details.

children.text: At ForgeWorks, good manufacturing starts with a clear understanding of the job. We review your drawings, discuss the materials and finishes, and identify the details that matter before production begins.
From custom metalwork to repeat components, our team pairs hands-on experience with careful planning. You get practical answers, responsive communication, and work shaped around your requirements.

image.alt: Fabrication worker cutting a metal pipe with an electric grinder

children.text: We agree on the dimensions, tolerances, and inspection requirements that matter to your project. Checks are built into the workflow, helping identify issues while there is still time to resolve them.
Material requirements, drawing revisions, and production milestones are discussed upfront. From setup to final inspection, we focus on delivering components that match the agreed specification.

image.alt: Manufacturing worker operating a machine control panel

page_builder.heading: A clear path from drawing to delivery.

children.text: Every project has different priorities. We work with you to understand the application, agree on the scope, and plan the next steps. Expect clear communication from the first conversation through the final handoff.

page_builder.heading: Before we get started.
page_builder.description: A few answers to help you plan your next manufacturing project.

repeater.heading: What do you need to prepare a quote?

children.text: Share your drawings or specifications, the required quantities, material and finish preferences, and your target delivery date. If some details are still being developed, we can discuss what is needed next.

repeater.heading: Can you help with prototypes and smaller runs?

children.text: Yes. We can discuss one-off components, prototypes, and repeat production. The best approach depends on the design, process, and quantity.

repeater.heading: Which materials can you work with?

children.text: Our sample capabilities include steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. Tell us the material grade and application so we can confirm the right manufacturing approach.

repeater.heading: How do you confirm production timelines?

children.text: Lead times depend on the scope, material availability, and production schedule. We discuss your target date during quoting and agree on a timeline before the project starts.

repeater.heading: Can you work to specific inspection requirements?

children.text: We review your tolerances, inspection needs, and documentation requirements with the quote. Any project-specific acceptance criteria are agreed before production begins.
